answer: The relic is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the prism. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the glacier of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
